Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: يَا ذَا الَّذِيْ كَانَ قَبْلَ كُلِّ شَيْئٍ
Translation: O He who existed before everything

Arabic text: يَا ذَا الَّذِيْ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْئٌ
Translation: O He who has nothing similar to Him

Arabic text: وَيَا ذَا الَّذِيْ لَيْسَ فِيْ السَّمَاوَاتِ الْعُلَى
Translation: And O He whom in the highest heavens
And not in the lowest earths

Arabic text: وَلَا فَوْقَهُنَّ وَلَا تَحْتَهُنَّ وَلَا بَيْنَهُنَّ إِلٰهٌ يُعْبَدُ غَيْرُهُ
Translation: And not above them, nor below them, nor between them is there any deity worshipped besides Him

Arabic text: لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا لَا يَقْوَى عَلَى إِحْصَائِهِ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
Translation: For You is all praise, such praise that none can enumerate except You

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلاَةً لَا يَقْوَى عَلَى إِحْصَائِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, blessings that none can enumerate except You
